checks.evidence: Step 2 of 'Sürekli profil verisinin yorumlanması' only says a value followed by a zero distance is taken into account. It gives no concrete profile, no V1 and V2 values, and no check that the permitted speed is reduced to V1 at the V1 location.
Step 1 mentions in general terms that the last value applies without limit. It has no scenario where the train passes the V1/V2 location and the permitted speed rises to V2.
